description: Fan out a seed keyword across autocomplete (seed + a-z + who/what/how/why/best/vs), People Also Ask and related searches, and get deduplicated ideas, each with source, question flag, intent (question, commercial, navigational, informational) and a 0-1 relevance score. volume is always null: there is no search-volume data, and the score is relevance (frequency across sources and positions), not volume. Billed per successful call; set quote_only=true to get the price first without running anything. Results are cached 7 days per seed, country and language and a cache hit costs half the quote.

depth.description: 1 (default) or 2, which also expands the best ideas (up to 60 calls).

quote_only.description: Return the quote without running or billing.

sources.description: Sources to use. Default: all three.

name: alterlab_keyword_ideas
title: Get Keyword Ideas
